notes.title: Early Access has Launched!
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to get this game in front of players. 

Thanks to our beta testers for helping us refine the game over the past few months.

Recent additions include: 
- Semi-opaque table walls to help guide your shots.
- Options for rotation pivot point: You can rotate around the cue-ball, around your hands, or around the center of the table.
- Updated sounds effects for the fruit and metal ball sets.

Please send us your feedback and bug reports in the Steam discussions pages for the game. Also, let us know if you have any ideas for game modes and other fun stuff. We will do our best to squash bugs quickly.

Enjoy the game! See you on the table!
